versions.changelog:
Initial release of doubao-tts skill for text-to-speech using Volcengine.

- Supports converting text to speech using Volcengine Doubao TTS API, with multiple voices, emotions, and speed/pitch/volume tuning.
- Provides detailed usage guide, including how to configure credentials and customize voice/emotion.
- Includes automatic emotion detection based on input text.
- Describes error handling, audio playback, and command line examples.
- Offers sample configuration and shell script for direct usage.
